stories.title: Create IT C01 System Architecture Knowledge Plans — Theory Lesson and Core Concepts
stories.description: Establish foundational IT WIM content for Competency Unit 01 (System Architecture Fundamentals) following JPK Buku Panduan format. Create theory lesson plan and five knowledge information sheets covering system fundamentals, hardware, software, security, and networking. Ensure complete coverage of IT-020-3:2013 CoCU-1 Related Knowledge items with bilingual terminology.
acceptanceCriteria: Create it-computer-system/C01/PM-teori.md with learning outcomes, theory content structure, and bilingual terms aligned to JPK format
Create it-computer-system/C01/KP(1/5).md through KP(5/5).md covering System Fundamentals, Hardware Components, Software Basics, System Security, Network Basics
Extract and document all NOSS IT-020-3 CoCU-1 Related Knowledge items in it-computer-system/00-noss-extract.md and verify 100% coverage in KP files
technicalNotes: Test coverage: grep -E 'Related Knowledge|RK[0-9]+' it-computer-system/00-noss-extract.md | wc -l should match grep count across KP files
Validate bilingual sections in each KP with EN term / BM term pair format

stories.title: Create BEV C04 Performance Assessment with Multi-Scenario Diagnostic Competency Rubric
stories.description: Build comprehensive performance assessment (PA) document for BEV C04 (Electrical Drive Systems) featuring four diagnostic scenarios and an integrated 5-point supervisor competency rubric (emerging to expert). Enable supervisors to assess student practical troubleshooting of real motor, inverter, and power system faults. Validate scenario alignment with NOSS CoCU Work Activities.
acceptanceCriteria: Create bev-diagnostic-rectification/C04/PA.md with 4+ diagnostic scenarios: motor failure modes, inverter malfunction, power distribution faults, HV system anomalies
Include 5-point supervisor competency rubric (Emerging, Developing, Proficient, Advanced, Expert) assessing diagnostic reasoning, troubleshooting methodology, and safety compliance
Map each scenario to C04 Work Activities (WA01-WA05) and Assessment Criteria from NOSS; achieve 100% coverage
technicalNotes: File to create: bev-diagnostic-rectification/C04/PA.md (performance assessment with JPK format)
Test command: grep -E 'WA[01-5]|Assessment Criteria AC[0-9]+' bev-diagnostic-rectification/C04/PA.md | wc -l (expect ≥ 8 references)
Verify each scenario includes [WA##] reference tag and each rubric row has 5 proficiency levels with descriptors

stories.title: Build Aesthetic Bilingual Term Standardization Tool — Validator, Report, and Fixer
stories.description: Create automated bilingual terminology validation and standardization system for Aesthetic Services WIM. Develop Python tool that scans all Knowledge Plans (KP) in C01-C04, identifies EN/BM term inconsistencies against master terminology reference, generates audit report with mismatches, and applies fixes. Ensures bilingual consistency goal across entire Aesthetic subject WIM.
acceptanceCriteria: Create aesthetic-services/_tools/terminology-validator.py with --check (report mode) and --fix (correction mode) supporting all C01-C04 KP files
Create aesthetic-services/_reference/terms.json with master bilingual terminology list (medical/spa EN→BM pairs)
Generate HTML validation report showing mismatches with file paths and line numbers; apply fixes achieving 100% term consistency across all C01-C04 KP files
technicalNotes: File to create: aesthetic-services/_tools/terminology-validator.py (Python script with JSON I/O and regex term matching)
File to create: aesthetic-services/_reference/terms.json (master bilingual term pairs)
Test command: uv run python aesthetic-services/_tools/terminology-validator.py --check > report.html && uv run python aesthetic-services/_tools/terminology-validator.py --fix
